title: TÜV Rheinland FUNCTIONAL SAFETY ENGINEER - SAFETY INSTRUMENTED SYSTEMS

fields.OBJECTIVE: The course is designed to provide participants with elementary and necessary knowledge about functional safety, based on the international standards IEC 61508 and IEC 61511.
fields.PARTICIPANTS: For instrument engineers, application engineers, site engineers, project managers, operation engineers, maintenance engineers and all those who are involved in the design, realization, maintenance and operation of safety systems.
fields.PREREQUISITE:
At least 3 years experience in the field of functional safety. Bachelor degree or equivalent as certified by the employer.
Pass score is 75%. Successful participants will receive certificate from TÜV Rheinland
fields.COURSE FEE: Please contact us for actual price.

days.title: 1st day
items: The 5 main pillars of the standards
Hazard and risk assessment, Determine SIF and SIL,SIL verification

days.title: 2nd day
items: DTS and ETS states, redundancy, safety architectures, reliability modeling, sensor validation, overrides-bypasses-inhibits, process safety time and system response time, Logic Solver architectures
Random hardware failures and their modes
Failure mode effect analysis, Safe Failure Fraction (SFF), Hardware Fault Tolerance (HFT)

days.title: 3rd day
items: Common cause influences and various errors
The beta factor and systematic and human failures

description: Learn functional safety and safety instrumented system concepts for engineers.

title: Introduction to process measurement & Centum VP

fields.OBJECTIVE: The course is designed to provide participants with the basic knowledge of process measurement and introduction to Centum VP system.
fields.PARTICIPANTS: For academic students who want to learn the principles of process measurement and Centum VP control system.
fields.PREREQUISITE: None
fields.COURSE FEE: Please contact us for actual price.

days.title: 1st day
items: Basic principles of process measurement and automatic control
Pressure measurement : terminology, working principles of various pressure sensing devices
Level measurement : working principles of different level sensing devices

days.title: 2nd day
items: Temperature measurement : terminology, working principles of temperature detectors
Flow measurement : terminology and working principles of flow measuring devices

days.title: 3rd day
items: Principle of operation and Alarm messages

days.title: 4th day
items: Operations of individual windows (Trend and Tuning View)

description: Explore the fundamentals of process measurement and the CENTUM VP system.
